# zinn_plans (Data Source)

The public hosting plan catalogue. Public: no API key needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zinn_plans" "agency" {
  product_line = "agency"
}

output "agency_plan_codes" {
  value = [for p in data.zinn_plans.agency.plans : p.code]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `product_line` (String) Only plans of this product line.

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) The plan code, e.g. `agency_start`.
- `id` (String) The plan's stable id.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `orderable` (Boolean) Whether the plan can be ordered now.
- `plan_version_id` (String) The purchasable version id of the plan.
- `product_line` (String) Product line the plan belongs to.
- `recommended` (Boolean) Whether the plan is the recommended one in its line.
- `sort_order` (Number) Display order.
